startup.interpretation: First-round cold p50 and warm p95 exceed the predeclared screen, but independent repetition does not reproduce either breach. All samples retained; warm p50 remains 14.010 to 25.581 ms slower. This is a bounded same-machine acceptance, not zero-overhead proof.

secondBatch.decision: Separate opt-in trial only after first-batch acceptance; modest symbol-only gain does not justify automatic expansion into background acquisition, timeline or rate-limit state
